name: SearchPin
description: Auto-append search modifiers (like site:reddit.com) to Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Ecosia, and Brave searches.

toggle-filter.description: Toggle SearchPin filter for the current results page

enable-filter.description: Apply filter — enable SearchPin for the current results page

disable-filter.description: Show all — disable SearchPin for the current results page

show-ui.description: Show / hide the SearchPin bar (used in Silent mode)

cycle-profile.description: Cycle to the next filter profile

cycle-profile-back.description: Cycle to the previous filter profile
